LanguageData.RC2_Coffee.label: coffee

LanguageData.RC2_GreenTea.description: An aromatic, bitter tea made from unfermented tea leaves. Not particularly rich in nutrients, but it does have a small amount of caffeine and is relaxing to drink.

LanguageData.RC2_MealCandy.description: A collection of hard and soft candy made from sweeteners. Usually eaten by the handful by the gluttonous.

LanguageData.RC2_MealCrustyPeanuts.description: A bag of delicous legumes! Peanuts, the all time favorite of circus-goers all along the rim and beyond. Grab a fresh hot handful of Crusty's Nuts today!

LanguageData.RC2_MealJuice.description: A tasty drink made from squeezing one or more fruits. Refreshing, though not particularly filling.
LanguageData.RC2_MealPastry.label: pastry
LanguageData.RC2_MealPastry.description: A soft, delicious and sugary sweet pastry often favored by law enforcement.
